choice_findings.finding_ko: ED에서 추가 monitoring이 필요한 반응은 routine report를 기다릴 수 없는 즉시 prescriber 통지 대상이다.
유효 처방에 의한 eligible buprenorphine injection이라도 제품 labeling과 해당 REMS를 함께 따라야 한다. 이 행위는 의무 준수를 지지하며 모든 제형의 retail 자가교부를 허용하지 않는다.
이 circular은 IV를 제외하고 SC/IM과 제조사 labeling을 요구하며 ceftriaxone은 IM으로 열거한다. IM 허용을 IV에 이전할 수 없다.
성인, 적격 single-dose LAI, 유효 처방, training/current CPR와 제품조건을 만족한 투여는 circular의 허용 경로이다. 나머지 전제는 stem의 명시 범위로 한정한다.
이 non-vaccine circular의 투여자는 pharmacist 또는 pharmacy intern이다. Technician의 별도 vaccine 경로를 LAI 권한으로 바꿀 수 없다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(ED에서 추가 monitoring이 필요한 반응은 routine report를 기다릴 수 없는 즉시 prescriber 통지 대상이다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은투여route와제품REMS/인력범위을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist waits for the next routine progress report after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist waits for the next routine progress report after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.”와E“A certified technician uses this non-vaccine administration circular to give an adult patient a long-acting antipsychotic injection.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist administers an eligible patient-specific long-acting antipsychotic under the current MH/SUD pathway. Which workflow principles are consistent with the guidance? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Send the administration record to the prescriber as soon after administration as practical, as strongly encouraged by DCP guidance
Allow a cashier to perform the injection after the pharmacist verifies the prescription
Skip privacy protections because the medication treats mental illness
Use a prescribed single dose supplied in eligible single-dose packaging
Document the administration in the pharmacy's patient record

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts retail pharmacy offers medication administration under DCP 26-03-124. The cases do not involve a hospital privilege or a separately authorized opioid treatment program. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacist uses the authority to administer a prescribed HIV-prevention injection as the basis for independently prescribing that injection.
A trained pharmacist with current CPR administers an eligible single-dose LAI to an adult under a valid prescription and product requirements.
A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.
A pharmacist immediately informs the prescriber after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.
A qualified intern administers an eligible adult patient’s IM medication under appropriate pharmacist supervision.

choice_findings.finding_ko: 유효 처방에 의한 eligible buprenorphine injection이라도 제품 labeling과 해당 REMS를 함께 따라야 한다. 이 행위는 의무 준수를 지지하며 모든 제형의 retail 자가교부를 허용하지 않는다.
적격 intern은 circular에 명시된 투여자이며 적절한 pharmacist supervision을 갖추는 행위가 지지된다. Technician이나 독립 prescribing을 허용한 문장이 아니다.
보험 claim만으로 patient consent/screening, 약품과 lot/expiry, route/site, 투여자 등 administration 기록을 생략할 수 없다.
Single-dose packaging과 처방 single doses가 함께 필요하고 refills는 있을 수도 없을 수도 있다. Refill 존재를 multidose packaging 허용으로 해석하지 않는다.
ED에서 추가 monitoring을 필요로 한 adverse outcome은 즉시 prescriber에게 보고한다. 통상24시간 communication과 구분한다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(유효 처방에 의한 eligible buprenorphine injection이라도 제품 labeling과 해당 REMS를 함께 따라야 한다. 이 행위는 의무 준수를 지지하며 모든 제형의 retail 자가교부를 허용하지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은투여route와제품REMS/인력범위을혼동한다. 실제오답C=A pharmacy keeps only the insurance claim and omits the administration-specific patient and product records.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacy keeps only the insurance claim and omits the administration-specific patient and product records.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.”와E“A pharmacist immediately informs the prescriber after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist administers an eligible patient-specific long-acting antipsychotic under the current MH/SUD pathway. Which workflow principles are consistent with the guidance? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Send the administration record to the prescriber as soon after administration as practical, as strongly encouraged by DCP guidance
Allow a cashier to perform the injection after the pharmacist verifies the prescription
Skip privacy protections because the medication treats mental illness
Use a prescribed single dose supplied in eligible single-dose packaging
Document the administration in the pharmacy's patient record

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts retail pharmacy offers medication administration under DCP 26-03-124. The cases do not involve a hospital privilege or a separately authorized opioid treatment program. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.

A pharmacist immediately informs the prescriber after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Retail CDTM은 Schedule II–V prescribing을 허용하지 않는다. Alprazolam은 연방IV이며 CPA에 추가해도 제한이 없어지지 않는다.
종료 전 uninterrupted continuation을 마련하고 종료/비갱신 시 written patient notice를 제공해야 한다. 환자에게 알리지 않고 끝내는 처리는 부합하지 않는다.
Community CDTM의 환자는18세 이상이다. 별도 hormonal contraception의 any-person 경로가 retail CDTM 연령을 지우지 않는다.
Retail에서는 supervising physician의 개별 written referral과 primary/secondary diagnosis 정보가 필요하다. 단순 store 신청과 다르다.
초기 Rx 또는 modification/discontinuation의 copy는 발행24시간 안에 physician에게 보내며 urgent 상황은 더 빠르다. 2년 CPA 갱신 때까지 미룰 수 없다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Retail CDTM은 Schedule II–V prescribing을 허용하지 않는다. Alprazolam은 연방IV이며 CPA에 추가해도 제한이 없어지지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제D의행위는A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“The parties terminate the collaboration without informing patients who still depend on its prescribing and monitoring.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.”와E“A pharmacist waits until the CPA’s next biennial review to communicate an initial prescription or therapy change.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A retail collaborative practice agreement expressly allows initial Schedule VI prescriptions. The supervising physician referred an adult patient with hypertension, and the collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI antihypertensive prescription for that referred diagnosis late Friday afternoon. The physician's office will not reopen until Monday. What should the pharmacist do next?

choices.text: Arrange to send a copy of the prescription to the supervising physician within 24 hours rather than waiting for the office to reopen.
Wait until Monday because the 24-hour copy requirement excludes weekends and holidays.
Keep the prescription only in the pharmacy's collaborative-practice file unless the supervising physician later requests a copy.
Send the prescription copy to the Board within 24 hours and provide it to the supervising physician at the next scheduled review.
No copy is required because the agreement already authorizes initial Schedule VI prescribing for the referred diagnosis.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
A pharmacist waits until the CPA’s next biennial review to communicate an initial prescription or therapy change.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A retail collaborative practice agreement expressly allows initial Schedule VI prescriptions. The supervising physician referred an adult patient with hypertension, and the collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI antihypertensive prescription for that referred diagnosis late Friday afternoon. The physician's office will not reopen until Monday. What should the pharmacist do next?

choices.text: Arrange to send a copy of the prescription to the supervising physician within 24 hours rather than waiting for the office to reopen.
Wait until Monday because the 24-hour copy requirement excludes weekends and holidays.
Keep the prescription only in the pharmacy's collaborative-practice file unless the supervising physician later requests a copy.
Send the prescription copy to the Board within 24 hours and provide it to the supervising physician at the next scheduled review.
No copy is required because the agreement already authorizes initial Schedule VI prescribing for the referred diagnosis.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.

choice_findings.finding_ko: 종료 전 치료 연속성 계획과 written notice를 마련하는 행위는 지지된다. 조문은 연속성은 prior to termination, written notice는 when terminated로 구분하므로 advance written notice만이 유일한 법정 시점이라고 단정하지 않는다.
보기의허용행위/특정grandfather경로판정은위와같다. 그러나해설의현재경험·equivalency가반드시필요하다는일반단정은MGL112§24B½(b)(3)/243CMR2.12(2)(c)의degree대안과247CMR16.02의제한관계가미해소이므로HOLD한다.
Retail CDTM 자체의 환자연령18세 이상을 확인한다. 별도 prescribing 제도를 혼합하지 않는다.
승인된 protocol과 physician supervision/direct consultation 아래 drug therapy에 직접 관련된 laboratory monitoring을 명시하고 diagnostic component를 부여하지 않는 범위가 CDTM 정의에 맞는다.
CPA는 pharmacist와 supervising physician이 적어도2년마다 review/renew한다. 환자별24시간 copy와 서로 다른 주기다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(종료 전 치료 연속성 계획과 written notice를 마련하는 행위는 지지된다. 조문은 연속성은 prior to termination, written notice는 when terminated로 구분하므로 advance written notice만이 유일한 법정 시점이라고 단정하지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.”와E“The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is evaluating the current statutory qualifications to enter a collaborative practice agreement. Which statements reflect M.G.L. c.112, § 24B1/2(b)? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Hold a current Massachusetts pharmacist license, currently practice in the Commonwealth, and maintain at least $1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.
Have earned a PharmD degree or completed five years of experience as a licensed pharmacist, or the equivalent.
Devote a portion of practice to the defined drug-therapy area and complete at least five additional related CE contact hours in each agreement year.
Apply for the statute's limited MassHealth ordering/referring participation if implementing regulations governing that participation are promulgated.
A pharmacist with a current PharmD must also complete five years of licensed-practice experience because the degree alternative is no longer recognized by statute.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.

exact_shared_options_with_other_family: A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A retail collaborative practice agreement expressly allows initial Schedule VI prescriptions. The supervising physician referred an adult patient with hypertension, and the collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI antihypertensive prescription for that referred diagnosis late Friday afternoon. The physician's office will not reopen until Monday. What should the pharmacist do next?

choices.text: Arrange to send a copy of the prescription to the supervising physician within 24 hours rather than waiting for the office to reopen.
Wait until Monday because the 24-hour copy requirement excludes weekends and holidays.
Keep the prescription only in the pharmacy's collaborative-practice file unless the supervising physician later requests a copy.
Send the prescription copy to the Board within 24 hours and provide it to the supervising physician at the next scheduled review.
No copy is required because the agreement already authorizes initial Schedule VI prescribing for the referred diagnosis.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: The pharmacist uses a verbal statement that consent exists instead of maintaining the required retail referral/consent records.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts supervising physician refers a patient for collaborative drug therapy management, records the referral and the patient's consent in his own chart, and tells the collaborating pharmacist that the documentation is complete and nothing further is needed. Where must the individual referral and consent be recorded?

choices.text: In the supervising physician's record alone, which is what the statute requires.
In the pharmacist's record alone, since the pharmacist delivers the service.
In whichever of the two records the professionals agree should hold them.
In the patient's record, by the pharmacist and by the supervising physician.
In a register filed with the Board, separately from the patient's record.

criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답A=The pharmacist uses a verbal statement that consent exists instead of maintaining the required retail referral/consent records.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A community pharmacy receives an individually signed referral for a patient to enter a collaborative drug therapy management program. The document lists the patient's name and address, primary diagnosis, authorized comorbid diagnoses, and detailed treatment instructions. It does not state the patient's known allergies and contains no statement that the patient gave written informed consent. The pharmacist notes that the affiliated hospital often begins inpatient collaborative management through a consultation request that does not contain those two items. What is the best conclusion for the community-pharmacy referral?

choices.text: It is sufficient because a signed referral and specific treatment instructions replace the need for allergy and consent information.
It is sufficient if the hospital's consultation process would accept the same document.
It is incomplete because a community CDTM referral must include known allergies and a statement of written informed consent, in addition to the other required patient-specific information.
It is incomplete only if the patient has a known allergy that would change the treatment instructions.
It may be completed by treating the hospital's consultation request as an incorporated attachment, even though that request contains neither missing item.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.
A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
The physician retains the original consent record and the pharmacist receives and retains the required copy.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts supervising physician refers a patient for collaborative drug therapy management, records the referral and the patient's consent in his own chart, and tells the collaborating pharmacist that the documentation is complete and nothing further is needed. Where must the individual referral and consent be recorded?

choices.text: In the supervising physician's record alone, which is what the statute requires.
In the pharmacist's record alone, since the pharmacist delivers the service.
In whichever of the two records the professionals agree should hold them.
In the patient's record, by the pharmacist and by the supervising physician.
In a register filed with the Board, separately from the patient's record.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The pharmacist uses a verbal statement that consent exists instead of maintaining the required retail referral/consent records.
A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.
A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A referred patient at a Massachusetts retail pharmacy has run out of a medication her supervising physician prescribed, and the physician is unreachable. The collaborating pharmacist has never dispensed this patient a different medication for the same condition. What may the pharmacist do under the retail collaborative power?

choices.text: Initiate an equivalent medication for the same condition for up to 30 days.
Extend the current therapy the supervising physician prescribed by 30 days.
Extend the current therapy indefinitely until the physician can be reached.
Substitute a therapeutically similar agent and notify the physician afterwards.
Nothing, because the retail setting confers no continuation power at all.

Ulipristal은 prescription 경로이고 levonorgestrel Plan B의 OTC 지위를 이 약에 이전할 수 없다. EC statewide order는 별도의 합법적 order 경로이다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide EC order의 사용자를 직접 또는 전화로 assess해야 한다. OTC EC의 제3자 구매와 별개이다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacist treats a blank model standing-order template as a signed order authorizing dispensing.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A pharmacist treats a blank model standing-order template as a signed order authorizing dispensing.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”와E“A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist has completed no training programme of any kind. She proposes to dispense emergency contraception under the statewide standing order this week, and to dispense a COVID-19 drug under a standing order next week. How do the two proposals compare?

choices.text: The emergency contraception dispensing may proceed; the COVID-19 drug may not.
The COVID-19 dispensing may proceed; the emergency contraception may not.
Both may proceed, because training is a professional expectation rather than a bar.
Neither may proceed, because both regimes require approved training beforehand.
Both may proceed once she notifies the Department that she intends to dispense.

Opill은 daily norgestrel 피임약이며 FDA는 emergency contraception 용도가 아니라고 명시한다. 요청 목적을 확인하지 않고 EC와 자동 대체하면 안 된다.
Opioid antagonist rescue-kit label과 counseling/information pamphlet은 병존 의무이다. Label만으로 후자를 생략할 수 없다.
보험 coverage 범위와 pharmacist prescribing modality는 독립된 판단이다. §19F의 patch/oral 권한은 보험에 injection이 포함됐다는 이유로 확대되지 않는다. 특정 plan의 모든 보장 범위를 인증한 문장이 아니다.
OTC 구매 자격과 보험 billing을 위한 prescription/order 경로를 구분한다. Naloxone OTC product를 cash로 구매하려는 사람에게 billing 절차만으로 Rx를 요구하지 않는다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide EC order의 사용자를 직접 또는 전화로 assess해야 한다. OTC EC의 제3자 구매와 별개이다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”와E“A pharmacy separates OTC purchase eligibility from the prescription or order used for insurance billing.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A valid Massachusetts doxycycline prescription for a chlamydia partner uses 'EPT' in place of the partner's name and address. The pharmacist will dispense it. Which record setup is appropriate?

choices.text: Create a separate profile and prescription label using the EPT designation in place of the partner name/address.
Place the partner's doxycycline under the index patient's profile as an extra refill.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A patient requests a public-health pharmacy service in Massachusetts. Each option identifies the pathway being used; billing rules do not independently expand prescribing authority. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.
A pharmacist treats a blank model standing-order template as a signed order authorizing dispensing.
A pharmacy maintains separate records for EC annual reporting and ordinary prescription dispensing.
A pharmacist sells prescription-only ulipristal without an order, applying the OTC status of levonorgestrel emergency contraception.
A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide order에 따른 actual user의 assessment 없이 absent user의 patient-specific EC 처방을 생성할 수 없다. Phone assessment나 OTC third-party 구매를 금지하는 주장은 아니다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A pharmacist confirms the applicable standing order before using its patient-specific dispensing pathway.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제A의문장“A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist confirms the applicable standing order before using its patient-specific dispensing pathway.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.”와E“A pharmacist treats EC standing-order participation as authority to independently prescribe any reproductive-health drug.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

Administer if the patient signs a pharmacy consent form.

Ask a technician to select the dose and administer it independently.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Statewide EC order의 사용자를 직접 또는 전화로 assess해야 한다. OTC EC의 제3자 구매와 별개이다.
Opill은 매일 복용하는 norgestrel 피임약이며 EC가 아니라는 설명은 FDA의 승인 발표와 일치한다.
Dispensing시 counseling과 opioid-antagonist information pamphlet을 제공해야 한다. 실제label의무도 별도로 남는다.
FDA OTC naloxone product의 cash 구매에 보험 workflow의 Rx 요건을 그대로 적용할 수 없다. 다른 prescription-only naloxone 제형을 모두 OTC라 한 것은 아니다.
EC order에 따른 dispensing과 모든 reproductive-health drug에 대한 general prescribing을 구분하는 행위는 지지된다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide EC order의 사용자를 직접 또는 전화로 assess해야 한다. OTC EC의 제3자 구매와 별개이다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답D=A pharmacy conditions a cash purchase of an OTC naloxone product on obtaining a prescription because the insurance workflow uses one.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제D의문장“A pharmacy conditions a cash purchase of an OTC naloxone product on obtaining a prescription because the insurance workflow uses one.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”와E“A pharmacist distinguishes permission to dispense under an EC standing order from a general license to prescribe any reproductive-health drug.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Opill은 daily norgestrel 피임약이며 FDA는 emergency contraception 용도가 아니라고 명시한다. 요청 목적을 확인하지 않고 EC와 자동 대체하면 안 된다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A pharmacy maintains separate records for EC annual reporting and ordinary prescription dispensing.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacy lacking requested opioid-antagonist stock ends the encounter without the required access referral.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacy maintains separate records for EC annual reporting and ordinary prescription dispensing.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.”와E“A pharmacy treats the rescue-kit label as replacing the applicable counseling and information-material obligations.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

모든 boxed warning 제품에 enrollment REMS가 있는 것은 아니다. FDA는 일부 약만 REMS가 필요하다고 설명하며 실제 제품의 현행 프로그램을 확인해야 한다.
BRIXADI weekly와 monthly는 다른 formulation/interval이다. Weekly doses를 합쳐 monthly dose로 만들 수 없고 환자별 ordered formulation과 승인된 conversion을 확인한다.
Clozapine REMS 제거와 label-based ANC monitoring 권고는 다르다. FDA는 제거 후에도 prescribing-information 빈도에 따른 monitoring을 권고한다. Pharmacist의 폐지된 REMS gate를 복원하지 않는다.

criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은제품별공급경로와monitoring/시행조건을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacy hands a patient-specific Sublocade dose to the patient to carry home, relying on the validity of the prescription.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: FDA 승인일과 implementation은 별도이다. 현재 page는 iPLEDGE 변경 시행을2026-11-15로 연기했으며 stem의10/26과 실제11/4 확인 모두 그 전이다. 이미 허용된 enforcement discretion과 미시행 workflow도 구분한다.
Depot SUBLOCADE/BRIXADI certification을 buprenorphine pain patch에 자동 적용할 수 없다. BUTRANS에는 별도 opioid-analgesic REMS 교육/상담 항목이 있어 REMS 자체가 전혀 없다고도 단정하지 않는다.
Boxed warning만 보고 존재도 확인하지 않은 enrollment program을 필수라고 요구할 수 없다. 제품별 현행 REMS 유무/범위를 확인한다.
SPRAVATO는 REMS-certified healthcare setting에서만 투여하고 최소2시간 monitoring을 받는다. Nasal route가 일반 take-home spray 권한을 만들지 않는다.
Clozapine REMS enrollment는2025-06-13 제거되어 현재 dispensing prerequisite로 요구하지 않는다. 임상적 monitoring은 별개이다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(FDA 승인일과 implementation은 별도이다. 현재 page는 iPLEDGE 변경 시행을2026-11-15로 연기했으며 stem의10/26과 실제11/4 확인 모두 그 전이다. 이미 허용된 enforcement discretion과 미시행 workflow도 구분한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist distinguishes an FDA-approved change from its later implementation date before changing a REMS workflow.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은제품별공급경로와monitoring/시행조건을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacist requires depot-buprenorphine REMS certification before dispensing a buprenorphine pain patch.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제E의문장“A pharmacist requires enrollment in the removed clozapine REMS before considering any clozapine prescription.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist distinguishes an FDA-approved change from its later implementation date before changing a REMS workflow.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist distinguishes an FDA-approved change from its later implementation date before changing a REMS workflow.”와E“A pharmacist requires enrollment in the removed clozapine REMS before considering any clozapine prescription.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: 모든 boxed warning 제품에 enrollment REMS가 있는 것은 아니다. FDA는 일부 약만 REMS가 필요하다고 설명하며 실제 제품의 현행 프로그램을 확인해야 한다.
폐지된 clozapine REMS enrollment를 dispensing 전제로 요구하지 않는 것이 맞다. ANC monitoring 권고와 다른 현재 안전 의무를 배제하지 않는다.
새 공지 자체만으로 예정된 dispensing-window 변경을 조기 시행할 수 없다. iPLEDGE는11/15/2026으로 연기되었고 기존 enforcement discretion은 그 문언 범위로만 적용한다.
Depot SUBLOCADE/BRIXADI certification을 buprenorphine pain patch에 자동 적용할 수 없다. BUTRANS에는 별도 opioid-analgesic REMS 교육/상담 항목이 있어 REMS 자체가 전혀 없다고도 단정하지 않는다.
State access protection만으로 federal product REMS certification을 면제할 수 없다. 현행 FDA Q&A는 certified pharmacy/recognized prescriber 경로를 요구한다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(모든 boxed warning 제품에 enrollment REMS가 있는 것은 아니다. FDA는 일부 약만 REMS가 필요하다고 설명하며 실제 제품의 현행 프로그램을 확인해야 한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist checks whether a drug has a current REMS rather than inferring enrollment requirements solely from a boxed warning.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은제품별공급경로와monitoring/시행조건을혼동한다. 실제오답C=A pharmacist implements a newly announced dispensing-window change before its stated implementation date.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacist implements a newly announced dispensing-window change before its stated implementation date.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist checks whether a drug has a current REMS rather than inferring enrollment requirements solely from a boxed warning.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist checks whether a drug has a current REMS rather than inferring enrollment requirements solely from a boxed warning.”와E“A pharmacy treats state access protections as eliminating the federal mifepristone REMS certification requirement.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts retail pharmacy receives a prescription for mifepristone 200 mg for medical termination of pregnancy through 10 weeks. The pharmacy is not currently certified in the Mifepristone REMS Program. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Retail pharmacies are categorically prohibited from dispensing mifepristone, even if they become REMS-certified.
The pharmacy must satisfy the current Mifepristone REMS pharmacy-certification requirements before dispensing under this pathway.
The prescription must come from a prescriber who satisfies the current Mifepristone REMS prescriber-certification requirement.
Massachusetts Schedule VI status does not erase the separate federal product-specific REMS conditions.
The pharmacy can substitute ordinary Schedule VI transfer documentation for REMS certification because mifepristone is not federally controlled.

choice_findings.finding_ko: 모든 boxed warning 제품에 enrollment REMS가 있는 것은 아니다. FDA는 일부 약만 REMS가 필요하다고 설명하며 실제 제품의 현행 프로그램을 확인해야 한다.
SPRAVATO는 REMS-certified healthcare setting에서만 투여하고 최소2시간 monitoring을 받는다. Nasal route가 일반 take-home spray 권한을 만들지 않는다.
TIRF는 FDA가 열거한 transmucosal immediate-release 제품의 별도 프로그램이다. Fentanyl patch에 자동 이전되지 않는다.2024생산중단/신규enrollment중단 공지도 확인했으며 신규 TIRF enrollment가 현재 가능하다고 주장하지 않는다.
BRIXADI weekly와 monthly는 다른 formulation/interval이다. Weekly doses를 합쳐 monthly dose로 만들 수 없고 환자별 ordered formulation과 승인된 conversion을 확인한다.
Certified delivery directly to healthcare provider이며 patient take-home injection 교부가 아니라는 SUBLOCADE 조건을 따른다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(모든 boxed warning 제품에 enrollment REMS가 있는 것은 아니다. FDA는 일부 약만 REMS가 필요하다고 설명하며 실제 제품의 현행 프로그램을 확인해야 한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist checks whether a drug has a current REMS rather than inferring enrollment requirements solely from a boxed warning.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은제품별공급경로와monitoring/시행조건을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacy treats Spravato as an ordinary take-home nasal spray because nasal products are often self-administered.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제A의문장“A pharmacist checks whether a drug has a current REMS rather than inferring enrollment requirements solely from a boxed warning.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist checks whether a drug has a current REMS rather than inferring enrollment requirements solely from a boxed warning.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist checks whether a drug has a current REMS rather than inferring enrollment requirements solely from a boxed warning.”와E“A pharmacy supplying Sublocade follows the certified delivery-to-healthcare-provider pathway rather than routine patient take-home injection.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

SPRAVATO는 REMS-certified healthcare setting에서만 투여하고 최소2시간 monitoring을 받는다. Nasal route가 일반 take-home spray 권한을 만들지 않는다.
FDA 승인일과 implementation은 별도이다. 현재 page는 iPLEDGE 변경 시행을2026-11-15로 연기했으며 stem의10/26과 실제11/4 확인 모두 그 전이다. 이미 허용된 enforcement discretion과 미시행 workflow도 구분한다.
Certified delivery directly to healthcare provider이며 patient take-home injection 교부가 아니라는 SUBLOCADE 조건을 따른다.
TIRF outpatient 프로그램은 그 제품군의 범위이다. Transdermal fentanyl patch에 TIRF enrollment를 적용할 근거가 되지 않는다.2024 신규enrollment중단도 확인했다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(해당 dispensing route의 mifepristone은 certified pharmacy와 certified prescriber의 처방 등 적용 REMS 조건을 따라야 한다. State access가 이 조건을 없애지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A certified pharmacy follows the applicable mifepristone REMS and valid-prescription requirements for its dispensing route.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은제품별공급경로와monitoring/시행조건을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacy treats Spravato as an ordinary take-home nasal spray because nasal products are often self-administered.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacist distinguishes an FDA-approved change from its later implementation date before changing a REMS workflow.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A certified pharmacy follows the applicable mifepristone REMS and valid-prescription requirements for its dispensing route.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A certified pharmacy follows the applicable mifepristone REMS and valid-prescription requirements for its dispensing route.”와E“A pharmacist applies the TIRF outpatient enrollment process to a fentanyl transdermal patch prescription.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A pharmacist is reviewing product-specific dispensing restrictions as of October 26, 2026. The question does not apply any future iPLEDGE implementation before its effective date. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

A pharmacy treats Spravato as an ordinary take-home nasal spray because nasal products are often self-administered.

A pharmacy supplying Sublocade follows the certified delivery-to-healthcare-provider pathway rather than routine patient take-home injection.

Methadone pain prescription의 ordinary CII 검토와 OUD maintenance의 OTP/제한된 dispense-only 경로는 다르다. 적응증을 확인하며 별도 예외를 일반 retailRx로 바꾸지 않는다.
2022년12월 X-waiver/NOI 요건이 제거되었다. 현재 DEA III authority와 state scope는 확인하지만 중단된 X identifier 부재만으로 적격 Rx를 거절하지 않는다.
ScheduleIII 분류, OUD 적응증, depot injection/HCP delivery의 제품조건은 별도 체크이다. 하나의 허용이 다른 조건을 면제하지 않는다.
Non-OTP emergency 경로는 referral을 준비하며1회3일분 이하를 dispense하지만 prescribe하지 못하고 갱신/연장이 안 된다. 다른법령 조건도 충족해야 한다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(처방/조제를 허가받은 자는 자기 환자의 medical/pharmaceutical care 목적에 PMP data를 제공받을 수 있다. 호기심 검색을 허용하지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist reviews an actual patient’s controlled-drug history for legitimate treatment-related care.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은적응증·공급대상과professionalresponsibility을혼동한다. 실제오답C=A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist reviews an actual patient’s controlled-drug history for legitimate treatment-related care.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist reviews an actual patient’s controlled-drug history for legitimate treatment-related care.”와E“A practitioner using the narrow federal emergency-dispensing exception evaluates its conditions and limited nonrenewable supply.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: Each scenario involves methadone. Which statements correctly reflect how indication changes the federal pharmacy pathway? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Methadone remains Schedule II whether it is used for pain or for opioid-use-disorder treatment.
A pain prescription automatically becomes invalid if the patient also has a history of OUD
A valid methadone prescription for pain can be evaluated under ordinary Schedule II prescription rules, subject to applicable state law
An ordinary community-pharmacy prescription written solely for ongoing OUD maintenance cannot be treated as routine Schedule II pain prescribing outside the applicable narcotic-treatment pathway
A qualifying non-OTP emergency provision is a narrow dispense-only bridge while referral is arranged

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A community pharmacist evaluates controlled-drug requests. The facts distinguish patient-specific prescriptions from stock orders and maintenance treatment from other indications. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A practitioner uses the narrow federal emergency-dispensing exception to issue renewable retail methadone maintenance prescriptions.
A pharmacist searches a neighbor’s controlled-drug history out of personal curiosity.
A pharmacist treats the scheduled-drug classification, indication, and delivery route as separate checks for a depot product.
A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.

Sell an equivalent OTC methadone product instead.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Emergency 예외는 dispense-only이고3일분/비갱신 제한이다. Renewable retail methadone maintenance prescriptions을 발행하는 경로가 아니다.
OUD maintenance 목적의 routine retail methadone 처방은 ScheduleII pain 처방으로 처리할 수 없다. OTP 또는 별도 좁은 dispense-only 예외를 충족해야 한다.
2022년12월 X-waiver/NOI 요건이 제거되었다. 현재 DEA III authority와 state scope는 확인하지만 중단된 X identifier 부재만으로 적격 Rx를 거절하지 않는다.
임상적으로 중요한 sedative 조합의 drug-drug interaction을 DUR에서 평가하고 조치 기록을 남기는 것은 지지된다. 실제조치의 임상내용까지 이 문항이 지정하지는 않는다.
Rx의 발신 확인과 별도로 material diversion 우려를 해결한 후 legitimate-purpose 판단을 해야 한다. Pharmacist의 corresponding responsibility가 남는다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Emergency 예외는 dispense-only이고3일분/비갱신 제한이다. Renewable retail methadone maintenance prescriptions을 발행하는 경로가 아니다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제D의행위는A pharmacist assesses a clinically significant sedative combination and records the intervention.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은적응증·공급대상과professionalresponsibility을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A practitioner uses the narrow federal emergency-dispensing exception to issue renewable retail methadone maintenance prescriptions.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist assesses a clinically significant sedative combination and records the intervention.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A practitioner uses the narrow federal emergency-dispensing exception to issue renewable retail methadone maintenance prescriptions.”와E“A pharmacist resolves material diversion concerns before dispensing even when the prescriber confirms sending the prescription.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

Reclassify methadone to Schedule III for this patient.
Sell an equivalent OTC methadone product instead.

choice_findings.finding_ko: GeneralIII refill rules는 depot 제품의 HCP-only delivery 조건을 면제하지 않는다. Classification과 REMS/제품경로를 함께 적용한다.
Patient Rx information transfer는 원처방정보/남은refill 기록의 이동이고 stock distribution은 registrant간 약품 공급 및 별도기록이다. 두 법적행위는 같지 않다.
Prescriber 발신 사실은 authentication일 뿐 legitimate purpose/corresponding responsibility를 자동 충족하지 않는다. Material diversion concern을 미해소한 채 교부하지 않는다.
임상적으로 중요한 sedative 조합의 drug-drug interaction을 DUR에서 평가하고 조치 기록을 남기는 것은 지지된다. 실제조치의 임상내용까지 이 문항이 지정하지는 않는다.
State 최대days supply는 상한이지 실제prescribed quantity를 늘릴 자동권한이 아니다. Quantity 변경은 적용되는 prescriber consultation을 충족해야 한다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(GeneralIII refill rules는 depot 제품의 HCP-only delivery 조건을 면제하지 않는다. Classification과 REMS/제품경로를 함께 적용한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A pharmacy distinguishes a patient-directed prescription transfer from a registrant-to-registrant transfer of stock bottles.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은적응증·공급대상과professionalresponsibility을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist uses the general Schedule III refill rules to bypass the depot product’s provider-delivery restriction.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacist releases a prescription with unresolved diversion concerns after confirming only that the prescriber sent it.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacy distinguishes a patient-directed prescription transfer from a registrant-to-registrant transfer of stock bottles.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist uses the general Schedule III refill rules to bypass the depot product’s provider-delivery restriction.”와E“A pharmacist recognizes a state supply allowance as an upper limit, not permission to dispense more than the prescribed quantity.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: During a prescriber call, a never-filled Demerol prescription is brought to a Massachusetts pharmacy 35 days after issue. What is the result?

choices.text: Dispense after confirming that the prescriber still wants the medication supplied.
The Schedule II prescription is invalid because more than 30 days have elapsed since issue.
Use the federal six-month refill clock because Demerol is controlled.
Transfer the prescription before dispensing to restore validity.
Treat 35 days as acceptable when no prior quantity was dispensed.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A community pharmacist evaluates controlled-drug requests. The facts distinguish patient-specific prescriptions from stock orders and maintenance treatment from other indications. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

A pharmacist uses the general Schedule III refill rules to bypass the depot product’s provider-delivery restriction.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A patient asks a Massachusetts pharmacy to obtain a prescription issued 13 months ago for a prescription-only drug that is not listed in Schedules I through V. The prescription record shows two authorized refills remaining. Which statements should the receiving pharmacist apply? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The remaining refills keep the prescription transferable until both have been dispensed.
The drug falls within Massachusetts Schedule VI because it is a prescription drug not otherwise placed in Schedules I through V.
The transfer must be declined because a Schedule VI prescription may not be transferred more than one year after issuance.
The transfer may proceed, but the receiving pharmacy must apply the federal six-month refill period for Schedule III through V prescriptions.
The rule allowing Schedule VI prescriptions to transfer in the same manner as Schedule III through V prescriptions does not displace the separate one-year transfer ceiling.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(2022년12월 X-waiver/NOI 요건이 제거되었다. 현재 DEA III authority와 state scope는 확인하지만 중단된 X identifier 부재만으로 적격 Rx를 거절하지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A pharmacy processes controlled stock for a practitioner through the lawful registrant-ordering route.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은적응증·공급대상과professionalresponsibility을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제A의문장“A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacy processes controlled stock for a practitioner through the lawful registrant-ordering route.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist rejects an otherwise eligible buprenorphine OUD prescription because its prescriber lacks a discontinued X-waiver identifier.”와E“A pharmacist releases a prescription with unresolved diversion concerns after confirming only that the prescriber sent it.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Patient prescription은 practitioner의 general stock 공급용이 아니다. 별도 lawful registrant ordering/distribution을 이용해야 한다.
Emergency 예외는 dispense-only이고3일분/비갱신 제한이다. Renewable retail methadone maintenance prescriptions을 발행하는 경로가 아니다.
현재 DEA III/state 권한을 확인하고 폐지된 X-waiver identifier를 요구하지 않는다. MATE training 등 다른 current registration 의무를 면제한 문장이 아니다.
허가된 quantity를 discussion 없이 state maximum으로 늘리는 것은 상한을 authorization으로 오해한다. Quantity 변경의 consultation과 기록이 필요하다.
임상적으로 중요한 sedative 조합의 drug-drug interaction을 DUR에서 평가하고 조치 기록을 남기는 것은 지지된다. 실제조치의 임상내용까지 이 문항이 지정하지는 않는다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Patient prescription은 practitioner의 general stock 공급용이 아니다. 별도 lawful registrant ordering/distribution을 이용해야 한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로OUD·pain·stock·DUR의처리를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제C의행위는A pharmacist confirms the prescriber’s current ordinary authority for buprenorphine rather than demanding a discontinued federal X-waiver identifier.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은적응증·공급대상과professionalresponsibility을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacy uses a patient prescription to supply a practitioner’s general office stock.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제D의문장“A pharmacist increases a controlled prescription’s quantity to the state maximum without the required prescriber discussion.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist confirms the prescriber’s current ordinary authority for buprenorphine rather than demanding a discontinued federal X-waiver identifier.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacy uses a patient prescription to supply a practitioner’s general office stock.”와E“A pharmacist assesses a clinically significant sedative combination and records the intervention.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A practitioner who is not separately registered as a narcotic treatment program faces an emergency while arranging a patient referral for opioid-use-disorder treatment. Which statements describe the narrow federal emergency narcotic-dispensing pathway? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The practitioner may dispense, rather than prescribe, the narcotic medication under the emergency provision
Not more than a three-day supply may be dispensed at one time while referral arrangements are being made
The emergency treatment under this provision may not be renewed or extended
Use the emergency provision only as a short bridge while referral for treatment is being arranged.
The practitioner may write a 30-day retail prescription and label it a three-day emergency

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A community pharmacist evaluates controlled-drug requests. The facts distinguish patient-specific prescriptions from stock orders and maintenance treatment from other indications. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A pharmacist increases a controlled prescription’s quantity to the state maximum without the required prescriber discussion.
A pharmacist fills a routine retail methadone prescription issued for OUD maintenance outside an authorized OTP pathway.
A pharmacist uses the general Schedule III refill rules to bypass the depot product’s provider-delivery restriction.
A pharmacist confirms the prescriber’s current ordinary authority for buprenorphine rather than demanding a discontinued federal X-waiver identifier.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: Each scenario involves methadone. Which statements correctly reflect how indication changes the federal pharmacy pathway? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Methadone remains Schedule II whether it is used for pain or for opioid-use-disorder treatment.
A pain prescription automatically becomes invalid if the patient also has a history of OUD
A valid methadone prescription for pain can be evaluated under ordinary Schedule II prescription rules, subject to applicable state law
An ordinary community-pharmacy prescription written solely for ongoing OUD maintenance cannot be treated as routine Schedule II pain prescribing outside the applicable narcotic-treatment pathway
A qualifying non-OTP emergency provision is a narrow dispense-only bridge while referral is arranged

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A community pharmacist evaluates controlled-drug requests. The facts distinguish patient-specific prescriptions from stock orders and maintenance treatment from other indications. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacy processes controlled stock for a practitioner through the lawful registrant-ordering route.
A pharmacist recognizes a state supply allowance as an upper limit, not permission to dispense more than the prescribed quantity.
A pharmacy documents a stock-bottle distribution only as a patient prescription refill transfer.
A pharmacist confirms the prescriber’s current ordinary authority for buprenorphine rather than demanding a discontinued federal X-waiver identifier.
A pharmacist distinguishes a legitimate methadone analgesia prescription from a methadone prescription written solely for OUD maintenance outside an OTP.

choice_findings.finding_ko: 허용변경 범위를 벗어난 변경은 새 법적요건을 충족한 처방이 필요하다. 단순 generic verbal approval이 모든 변경의 new prescription을 대신한다는 뜻은 아니다.
형식상 DEA check digit은 state scope/current registration 및 실제 identity를 증명하지 않는다. Authority가 의심되면 필요한 current 권한을 확인해야 한다.
Employee/agent는 practitioner가 정한 Rx를 전달할 수 있지만 독립 drug/dose 선택을 하는 prescriber가 되지는 않는다.
연방controlled 약의 quantity를 insurance package에 맞춰 discussion 없이 바꿀 수 없다. CII는 prescriber, III–V는 해당 authorized agent consultation 범위도 구분한다.
Immediate inpatient administration order의 예외를 outpatient take-home discharge Rx에 옮길 수 없다. 발신기관 명칭보다 실제 order/dispensing 형태가 기준이다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 처방변경·agent·등록·퇴원처방에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(허용변경 범위를 벗어난 변경은 새 법적요건을 충족한 처방이 필요하다. 단순 generic verbal approval이 모든 변경의 new prescription을 대신한다는 뜻은 아니다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로처방변경·agent·등록·퇴원처방를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist obtains a new legally sufficient authorization when the requested change cannot be made under the permitted-change rules.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은처방권한과변경/예외조건을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacist verifies the DEA check digit but does not check the prescriber’s current schedule authority when that authority is in doubt.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제A의문장“A pharmacist obtains a new legally sufficient authorization when the requested change cannot be made under the permitted-change rules.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist obtains a new legally sufficient authorization when the requested change cannot be made under the permitted-change rules.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist obtains a new legally sufficient authorization when the requested change cannot be made under the permitted-change rules.”와E“A pharmacy uses the hospital’s inpatient-order exception for a take-home discharge prescription.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts practitioner holds a valid professional license and an MCSR authorizing Schedule VI activity but does not yet have a DEA registration. The practitioner issues an otherwise valid prescription for an ordinary Schedule VI drug. Which registration statement is most accurate?

choices.text: The prescription is invalid because a DEA registration is required for every Massachusetts prescription drug, including Schedule VI.
The MCSR supports Schedule VI-only activity; DEA registration is needed when the practitioner conducts federally controlled Schedule II-V activity.
The MCSR is relevant only to Schedule I activity, so it does not authorize this Schedule VI prescription.
The pharmacy may place its DEA number on the prescription to cover the practitioner's missing federal registration.
Schedule VI prescribing requires neither an MCSR nor DEA registration when the drug is not federally controlled.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A pharmacist is reviewing incoming prescriptions in Massachusetts. Any electronic-prescribing exception mentioned below is valid; it does not waive other controlled-drug requirements. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacist obtains a new legally sufficient authorization when the requested change cannot be made under the permitted-change rules.
A pharmacy distinguishes an inpatient immediate-administration order from an outpatient discharge prescription.
A pharmacist increases the quantity of a federally controlled prescription to match an insurance package size without discussing the change.
A pharmacist verifies the DEA check digit but does not check the prescriber’s current schedule authority when that authority is in doubt.
A pharmacist treats a successful insurance adjudication as resolving credible prescription-forgery concerns.
